parameter.name: inputs
parameter.label: Input Items
parameter.description: Items whose state changes are watched by this zone (Contact or Switch).

options.option: Informational - never triggers; only listed at arm-complete

parameter.name: armModes
parameter.label: Arm Modes
parameter.description: Comma-separated list of arm modes that arm this zone. HOME, AWAY, or both ("HOME,AWAY").

parameter.name: inputTrigger
parameter.label: Input Trigger
parameter.description: Which input value counts as a violation. AUTO uses OPEN for Contact, ON for Switch.

parameter.name: suppressionWindow
parameter.label: Suppression Window
parameter.description: HH:mm-HH:mm during which the zone is suppressed (e.g. 04:00-08:00 for HVAC false-positive period).

parameter.name: suppressWhenItemsOn
parameter.label: Suppress When Item(s) ON
parameter.description: Items whose state, when ON (Switch/Group) or OPEN (Contact), suppresses this zone. Use to silence motion sensors during airflow from air-conditioning, dryer vent, etc. Comma-separated for multiple. Suppressed violations are still audit-logged as ZONE_SUPPRESSED.

parameter.name: requireSustainedSeconds
parameter.label: Sustained (s)
parameter.description: Input must stay in the violating state for this many seconds before counting.

parameter.name: label
parameter.label: Label
parameter.description: Friendly label used in audit log entries.
